title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
syn: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.
syn_fr: Les aventures du successeur du dernier Avatar qui doit empêcher la nation du Feu d’asservir les nations de la Terre, de l’Eau et de l’Air...
title_fr: La Légende de Aang - le dernier maître de l'air

title: The Mandalorian and Grogu: Danger in the Dark
syn: The Mandalorian and Grogu: Danger in the Dark is a one-shot comic book that serves as a prequel to the 2026 film Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu. First announced on May 4, it was published by Mad Cave Studios' PaperCutz imprint on July 22, and was written by Delilah S. Dawson.
wiki: The Mandalorian and Grogu: Danger in the Dark
syn_fr: The Mandalorian and Grogu: Danger in the Dark est une bande dessinée one-shot écrite par Delilah S. Dawson dans le cadre de la sortie du film The Mandalorian and Grogu.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
syn: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
syn_fr: Quatre ans se sont écoulés, Peter, désormais adulte, vit seul, s'est volontairement effacé de la vie et des souvenirs de ses proches. Luttant contre le crime dans un New York qui ne le reconnaît plus, il se consacre entièrement à la protection de la ville - un Spider-Man à plein temps - mais à mesure que les responsabilités s'intensifient, la pression provoque une transformation physique surprenante qui menace son existence, tandis qu'une étrange nouvelle vague de crimes donne naissance à l'une des menaces les plus redoutables qu'il ait jamais affrontées.

title: Kya and the Secret of the Sand
kind: Graphic Novel Chronology: XXX AG Release Date: July 28, 2026

title: Legacy
syn: Legacy is an upcoming Star Wars novel that will be published in hardcover by Random House Worlds on July 28, 2026 alongside its audiobook. It was officially announced at New York Comic Con on October 11, 2025, where it was revealed to be a story written by Madeleine Roux focusing on Rey's Jedi training between the events of Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi and Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise o…
syn_fr: Legacy est un roman écrit par Madeleine Roux. Il sera publié le 28 juillet 2026 par Random House Worlds aux États-Unis. Il sera adapté en livre audio aux États-Unis. En France, il sera publié par Pocket en 2027.

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi
syn: Kara and her ragtag Jedi crew seek out to find worthy Jedi to fight against an increasingly powerful warlord.
title_fr: スター・ウォーズ：ビジョンズ／九人目のジェダイ

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 1
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 1 is the first issue of the upcoming 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on August 12, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 1 est le premier numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: Lanterns
syn: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.
syn_fr: Deux flics intergalactiques, la nouvelle recrue John Stewart et le légendaire Hal Jordan, sont confrontés à un sombre mystère sur Terre alors qu’ils enquêtent sur un meurtre au fin fond de l’Amérique.

title: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 4
syn: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 4 is the upcoming fourth issue of the 2026 comic book series Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders. The issue will be written by George Mann, illustrated by Partha Pratim, Jagdish Kumar, and Michael Atiyeh, and published by Dark Horse Comics on August 19, 2026.
syn_fr: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 4 est le quatrième numéro de la mini-série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders écrit par George Mann dans le cadre du projet multimédia Star Wars : La Haute République.

title: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire 5
syn: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire 5 is the upcoming fifth and final issue of the canon 2026 comic book miniseries Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire. The issue will be written by Ethan Sacks, illustrated by Roi Mercado and Jethro Morales, and published by Marvel Comics on August 19, 2026.
wiki: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire 5
syn_fr: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire 5 est le cinquième et dernier numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire écrit par Ethan Sacks.

title: Star Wars Zero Company
syn: Star Wars Zero Company is an upcoming canon single-player turn-based tactics video game that takes place during the Clone Wars. The game is developed by Bit Reactor in collaboration with Electronic Arts's Respawn Entertainment and published by EA and Lucasfilm Games, set to release on August 27, 2026.

title: Meet Team Avatar (Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender)
kind: Young Readers Novel Release Date: September 1, 2026

title: Hiding from the Dark
syn: Hiding from the Dark is a horror-themed middle grade novel written by Kiersten White that will be published by Random House on September 1, 2026.
syn_fr: Hiding from the Dark est un roman jeunes adultes d'horreur écrit par Kiersten White. Il sera publié le premier septembre 2026 par Disney–Lucasfilm Press aux États-Unis. Il sera adapté en livre audio aux États-Unis.

title: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 5
syn: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 5 is the upcoming fifth issue of the 2026 comic book series Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders. The issue will be written by George Mann, illustrated by Vincenzo Riccardi, Jagdish Kumar, and Michael Atiyeh, and published by Dark Horse Comics on September 9, 2026.
syn_fr: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 5 est le cinquième numéro de la mini-série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders écrit par George Mann dans le cadre du projet multimédia Star Wars : La Haute République.

title: The Book of Boba Fett 1
syn: The Book of Boba Fett 1 is the first issue of the upcoming comic adaptation of the television series Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett. Written by Rodney Barnes and drawn by Will Sliney, it will adapt "Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land" and will be published on September 9, 2026.

title: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss
syn: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss is an upcoming canon novel and the second entry of the Star Wars: Reign of the Empire trilogy written by Rebecca Roanhorse and set to be published by Random House Worlds on September 15, 2026. An audiobook version is set to be released along side the novel. It will be set in 6 BBY, one year before the first season of Star Wars: Andor.
wiki: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss
syn_fr: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss est un roman écrit par Rebecca Roanhorse. Il est le deuxième roman de la trilogie Star Wars : Le Règne de l'Empire. Il sera publié le 15 septembre 2026 par Random House Worlds aux États-Unis. Il fut adapté en livre audio aux États-Unis. En France, il sera publié par Pocket en 2027.

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 2
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 2 is the second issue of the upcoming 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on September 16, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 2 est le deuxième numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: The Book of Boba Fett 2
syn: The Book of Boba Fett 2 is the upcoming second issue of the comic adaptation of the television series Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett. Written by Rodney Barnes and drawn by Will Sliney, it will adapt "Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine" and will be published on September 23, 2026.

title: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
syn: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty is the first entry in Star Wars: Smugglers and Scoundrels, a line of canon graphic novels published by Mad Cave Studios. Written by Cavan Scott and illustrated by Christian Colbert, it will be released on October 6, 2026.
wiki: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
syn_fr: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty est une bande dessinée one-shot écrite par Cavan Scott.

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
syn: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is an upcoming canon Star Wars racing video game developed by Fuse Games and published by Lucasfilm Games alongside Secret Mode. The game will be released for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S on October 6, 2026.

title: VisionQuest
syn: After the events of WandaVision, White Vision struggles to connect with the memories given to him as he lacks the emotions or feelings associated with them.

title: Rogue One - Chirrut & Baze 1
syn: Rogue One – Chirrut & Baze 1 is a canon one-shot comic that will be published by Marvel Comics as part of the Star Wars: Rogue One one-shots for the ten-year anniversary of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story. Focusing on Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe, it will be written by Stephanie Phillips with art by Kieran McKeown, and will be released on October 14, 2026.
syn_fr: Rogue One – Chirrut & Baze 1 est le quatrième numéro de la série de bandes dessinées one-shots Star Wars: Rogue One. Il est écrit par Marc Bernardin.

title: Hyperspace Stories: Mace
syn: Hyperspace Stories: Mace is an upcoming graphic novel in the Star Wars: Hyperspace Stories series of graphic novels featuring a young Mace Windu. The issue will be written by Justina Ireland, illustrated by Georges Duarte and PH Gomes, and published by Dark Horse Comics on October 20, 2026.
syn_fr: Hyperspace Stories: Mace est un numéro one-shot de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars : Histoires de l'hyperespace écrit par Justina Ireland.

title: Clayface
syn: Follow the terrifying descent into hell of a promising Hollywood actor who has become a monster driven by revenge, exploring the loss of identity and humanity, the ravages of toxic love and the dark side of scientific ambition.
syn_fr: L'ascension fulgurante de Matt Hagen, de gamin des rues de Gotham à star hollywoodienne, est brutalement interrompue lorsqu'un baron du crime le laisse atrocement défiguré. Abandonné de tous et n'ayant plus rien à perdre, Matt se tourne vers un traitement expérimental qui lui rend miraculeusement son apparence... mais altère profondément sa perception de la réalité. Il sombre alors dans une spirale destructrice, consumé par un irrépressible désir de vengeance.

title: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 6
syn: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 6 is the upcoming sixth and final issue of the 2026 comic book series Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders. The issue will be written by George Mann, illustrated by Vincenzo Riccardi, and published by Dark Horse Comics on October 21, 2026.
syn_fr: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 6 est le sixième et dernier numéro de la mini-série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders écrit par George Mann dans le cadre du projet multimédia Star Wars : La Haute République.

title: Rogue One - Darth Vader 1
syn: Rogue One – Darth Vader 1 is a canon one-shot comic that will be published by Marvel Comics as part of the Star Wars: Rogue One one-shots for the ten-year anniversary of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story. Focusing on Darth Vader, it will be written by Chris Condon with art by Luke Ross, and will be published on October 28, 2026.
syn_fr: Rogue One – Darth Vader 1 est le cinquième et dernier numéro de la série de bandes dessinées one-shots Star Wars: Rogue One. Il est écrit par Chris Condon.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
syn: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
syn_fr: Les Avengers, les Wakandais, les Quatre Fantastiques, les New Avengers et les X-Men, tous héros issus de trois univers distincts se retrouvent sur une trajectoire de collision mortelle et font face à une menace existentielle sans précédent, comme ils n'en ont jamais rencontré auparavant, le Docteur Doom.

title: Build the Flame!
kind: Junior Novel Chronology: XXX BG Release Date: January 5, 202

title: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
syn: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon is the first entry in Star Wars: Tales from the Outer Rim, a line of canon graphic novels published by Mad Cave Studios. Written by Greg Pak and illustrated by Brent Schoonover, it will be released on January 26, 2027, though it was originally solicited for October 13, 2026.
wiki: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
syn_fr: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon est une bande dessinée one-shot écrite par Greg Pak.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
syn: An original story set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
syn: Hunted by Miguel O'Hara's Spider Society and betrayed by his friends, Miles finds himself in the darkest corners of the Spider-Verse in search of a way home. Knowing that his family has been not only fractured but endangered by his calling, it's a race against the clock for Miles to travel across the wildest reaches of time and space to fight for and reunite everything he holds most dear.

title: Man of Tomorrow
syn: Superman and Lex Luthor team up to face a larger threat.

title: Avengers: Secret Wars
syn: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga. Plot TBA.
syn_fr: Adaptation de Secret Wars de Jim Shooter et un prochain film de la phase 6 du Marvel Cinematic Universe qui conclura la saga du multivers.
